resources.string: YABA changes the S2’s alarm only once the test on a real bike has confirmed it. In S2 test mode it works already; the switch is in Diagnostics under S2 drive, at the bottom.
An S2 usually releases the Kick Lock only once you roll the bike while the unlock animation runs.
To lock an S2, push the Kick Lock down with your foot.
The S2 has no Bluetooth command for the bell tone, sounds or a custom bell.
An S2 can only set a backup code; it cannot clear or show it. Please remember the new code before you send it.
Enter the number the bike shows on its display, for example 16.
Older VanMoof: YABA does not support this model.
The S2 and X2 use a different Bluetooth protocol than the S3 and X3. Choose your bike’s model so YABA talks to it correctly.
